name: com.clawup/claw-vault
description: Clawup agent wallet MCP server backed by Privy. Creates policy-bound agent wallets and exposes constrained wallet tools for hosted agents.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVY_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Privy app ID from the Privy Dashboard

environmentVariables.name: PRIVY_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Privy app secret from the Privy Dashboard

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key required for HTTP MCP calls

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to http for ClawUp deployment

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_ALLOWED_CAIP2
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CAIP-2 chain allowlist for transaction submission

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_WALLET_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local agent wallet mapping JSON store
